sentences: Ring-LWE places noisy linear equations in an algebraic ring rather than an unstructured vector space.
The survey asks for a meaningful classical reduction from worst-case problems to this average-case task.
Such a reduction would explain how solving generated ring-LWE instances could solve every instance of an associated structured lattice problem.
A classical connection could strengthen the interpretation of the hardness assumption without invoking quantum computation.
The saved note does not define the intended quantitative strength or ring family, so “meaningful” still needs explicit approximation, dimension, and noise parameters.
